name: A Fish-Mas Carol
source:
The ghost of Scrooge's partner, Jacob Marley, appears bearing an urgent message on Fish-mas Eve.

[From [url=https://ashleecraft.itch.io/a-fish-mas-carol-demo-edition]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「魚誕節」前夜，斯克魯奇已故的合夥人雅各．馬萊以幽靈之身現形，帶來一個緊急訊息。

（來源：[url=https://ashleecraft.itch.io/a-fish-mas-carol-demo-edition]itch.io[/url]）
